records.title: Operations Early Career Entry Program — January–July 2027
records.location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Coimbatore, Mumbai and an additional India office
records.benefit: Structured training, mentoring and networking; stipend not disclosed.
records.duration: January–July 2027; five office days weekly throughout.
records.eligibility: Full-time undergraduates; finance, accounting and economics preferred, other disciplines accepted. English, analytical skills and basic MS Office required.
records.description: Investment-servicing placements span fund accounting, treasury operations, derivatives processing, middle office, pricing, compliance, AML and risk. Assignment is to one department.
records.applicationSteps: Apply through requisition R-799807 on State Street Workday before 13 November.
records.evidence: Live Workday page displayed Apply, the 13 November closing date and India locations on 2 November.
records.caveat: The employer uses both final-year and penultimate-year wording: confirm your graduation-year eligibility. Department choice and permanent employment are not guaranteed. One location is an office code.

records.title: Intern — Corporate Finance, M&A and Fundraising Advisory
records.eligibility: Strong academics in finance, economics or business; preference for top-tier universities. MBA graduates and those nearing completion welcome. CFA Level I is a plus, not mandatory.
records.description: Support transaction models, pitch materials, data rooms, fundraising and M&A execution at a corporate-finance advisory firm.
records.applicationSteps: Email a one-page CV and LinkedIn profile to internship@alehar.com, following the employer's careers page.
records.evidence: Official role page lists this opening, stipend, duration and a direct application email.
records.caveat: Academic selectivity is explicitly stated. No closing date is published; ask about the next available joining slot.

records.title: Finance Intern — Accounts Receivable and Credit
records.eligibility: Recent graduate in finance, accounting, business or a related field; Excel, data analysis and communication skills.
records.description: Support APAC billing and collections, receivables ageing, cash forecasts, credit checks and reconciliation, including withholding-tax documentation.
records.applicationSteps: Upload your CV through Aleph's Lever application form.
records.evidence: Official Lever detail page and Mumbai jobs board retain an active application route.
records.caveat: This is corporate receivables and credit operations. No published closing date or conversion commitment.

records.title: Finance Intern — Remote India
records.eligibility: Accounting, finance or related bachelor's degree. Employer asks for 1–6+ months of finance/accounting experience, Zoho Books or QuickBooks, and Google Workspace. ACCA candidates preferred.
records.description: Work on AP/AR, billing and collections, reconciliations, budget and variance analysis, audit support and financial/tax due diligence.
records.applicationSteps: Apply using the employer's Lever form with your CV.
records.evidence: Live browser verification showed the full India-specific description and Apply link; the application form also loaded.
records.caveat: Some prior practical experience is requested. ACCA is a preference, not a compulsory certification.

records.title: Intern — Income Tax Laws / Business Tax
records.location: Bengaluru in title; Gurugram/Hyderabad in description — confirm
records.eligibility: BCom/BBM with basic US individual-tax knowledge. The description also permits other graduates with US-tax training. Prior preparation/review experience is waived for freshers.
records.description: Review tax documents, reconcile information and support US individual income-tax computations and returns.
records.applicationSteps: Use Apply now on Deloitte South Asia's official role page; verify the work location before accepting.
records.evidence: Live rendered official page shows the full description and direct Apply now route.
records.caveat: Employer page contains a location mismatch. In-person work is stated; remote work is not offered.

records.title: Industrial Trainee — Finance and Accounting
records.benefit: Compensation not disclosed; potential full-time conversion based on performance.
records.eligibility: CA Intermediate cleared, one or both groups; currently pursuing CA internship/articleship and planning to complete CA. Accounting/tax exposure, Excel and accounting-software familiarity requested.
records.description: Support bookkeeping, monthly close, GST/TDS, audits, ledger reconciliations and statutory reporting.
records.applicationSteps: Complete the employer's Greenhouse form, including CV, education, experience and availability.
records.evidence: Official Greenhouse description and submit-application form are accessible.
records.caveat: Confirm whether this six-month engagement qualifies for your required ICAI training credit; the employer's label alone does not establish eligibility.

records.title: 2027 Actuarial Analyst Graduate Programme — Insurance Consulting and Technology
records.benefit: Full-time graduate role; salary not disclosed.
records.eligibility: Final-year bachelor's students in commerce, economics, maths, statistics, business, analytical or computing disciplines. Actuarial study or strong commitment to it, Excel and analytical skills required.
records.description: Insurance work covers pricing, valuation, financial reporting, actuarial transaction due diligence, capital modelling and enterprise risk.
records.applicationSteps: Start the application for requisition 202604904. Selection includes recorded video, technical assessment, final interview and HR discussion.
records.evidence: Official WTW role page has an application form; its Oracle careers index also lists the India requisition as hybrid.
records.caveat: No minimum number of actuarial exam passes is specified. This is graduate recruitment, not an internship.

records.title: CA Intern — Investment Bank Product Control
records.eligibility: University degree or equivalent, preferably CA/MBA; 0–3 years in product control, financial control or internal controls. Excel and strong English required.
records.description: Prepare and explain trading P&L and balance-sheet movements, reconcile ledgers, support month-end close and maintain control evidence.
records.applicationSteps: Select Apply now for job reference 345388BR on UBS Careers.
records.evidence: Live rendered page shows 29 October publication, Hyderabad location and Apply now.
records.caveat: The title says CA Intern but the description allows a broader degree profile. ICAI industrial-training recognition is not stated.

records.title: Internship — Operations Analyst
records.location: Bengaluru; description also lists Mumbai and Chennai
records.benefit: Training and completion certificate; potential permanent-role conversion. Stipend not disclosed.
records.duration: 4 months; five office days weekly; APAC, EMEA or US shifts.
records.eligibility: Any bachelor's degree; 6–24 months of banking, operations or similar experience. Excel, financial-product, payments and reconciliation knowledge requested.
records.description: Support securities services, market operations, banking, wealth or asset-management operations through reconciliations, processing and compliance controls.
records.applicationSteps: Follow Apply on the official listing, reference 123456789010118207.
records.evidence: Official description and Apply link are live; current Bengaluru transaction-processing directory also lists it.
records.caveat: Requires some experience despite the internship title. Final location, shift and any conversion depend on the employer.

records.title: CA Industrial Trainee — Accounting and Reporting
records.duration: Not disclosed; application asks remaining articleship availability.
records.eligibility: CA students eligible for industrial training, with strong accounting fundamentals. US GAAP or IFRS knowledge is advantageous.
records.description: Join international accounting/reporting for monthly close, journals, reconciliations, audit schedules, GST/withholding-tax support and SOX controls.
records.applicationSteps: Apply on Rubrik's official page with CV, cover letter and articleship availability.
records.evidence: Official role has a submit-application form; finance careers directory lists it among two open Bengaluru positions.
records.caveat: Confirm training length and ICAI eligibility with the recruiter. No official deadline is published.

records.title: US Tax Intern
records.benefit: Employer lists ₹3–3.5 lakh per year; confirm internship pay structure.
records.duration: Not disclosed; 12 pm–9 pm IST office hours.
records.eligibility: CPA or EA qualification is mandatory. Accounting/equivalent bachelor's student or recent graduate, US-tax understanding, Excel/Sheets and strong English required.
records.description: Prepare US corporate-tax workpapers and returns, information filings, tax research and responses to notices while working with startup clients.
records.applicationSteps: Select Apply for this job on Inkle's official careers page.
records.evidence: Official current-jobs directory and role page list this opening, salary and application control.
records.caveat: Certification is a hard eligibility condition. Title says intern while employment metadata says full-time/professionals; clarify contract and duration.

records.title: US Bookkeeper Intern
records.benefit: Employer lists ₹6 lakh per year; confirm four-month stipend calculation.
records.eligibility: Finance MBA students; description targets 2025/2026 graduates. QuickBooks Online, Xero and spreadsheet skills, financial-statement knowledge and English required.
records.description: Own monthly bookkeeping, bank/card reconciliation, financial statements and tax/audit-ready records for US startup clients.
records.applicationSteps: Apply through the official Inkle careers page with your CV.
records.evidence: Current company directory and role page show the internship, four-month term, salary field and Apply control.
records.caveat: Training hours are 12 pm–9 pm; later shifts are 3 pm–midnight or 5 pm–2 am IST. Conversion is possible, not guaranteed.

records.title: Compliance Associate Intern
records.eligibility: Students or fresh graduates in commerce, finance, law, business or related subjects; no previous experience required. English, attention to detail and basic workplace-software skills.
records.description: Prepare and track US corporate filings, annual reports and franchise-tax obligations, verify documents and manage client compliance deadlines.
records.applicationSteps: Use Apply for this job on the company careers page.
records.evidence: Official current-jobs directory and application page confirm the internship and monthly stipend.
records.caveat: Corporate compliance includes substantial documentation and customer support. Some US-hours overlap is required.

records.title: Payroll Industrial Trainee
records.eligibility: Description names CA industrial-training eligibility and finance graduates/postgraduates including BCom, MCom and MBA. Excel, communication and accuracy required; payroll experience preferred.
records.description: Support US/Canada payroll data validation, employee records, statutory compliance, reconciliations, reporting and audit requests from the Bengaluru finance team.
records.applicationSteps: Apply using Rubrik's official form for requisition INT11617.
records.evidence: Official finance directory lists the Bengaluru opening; role page includes a current submit-application form.
records.caveat: Confirm whether non-CA graduates qualify and whether your arrangement carries ICAI training credit; the description mixes intern, apprentice and industrial-trainee terminology.
